duePlans.title: Plans due
duePlans.subtitle: Link, skip, or add manually
duePlans.autoLinkedRule: The only recorded transaction that matches exactly (account, amount, around the due date) is linked to this plan. Undo it if wrong, and that transaction is never linked to the same plan automatically again.
duePlans.unlinkFailed: The link was not removed. Try again.
duePlans.dueCount: {count, plural, one {# plan due} other {# plans due}}
duePlans.dueRule: Plans do not change balances. Link a transaction already recorded, skip it if it did not happen, or add it manually only when its notification was missed.
duePlans.matchNone: No recorded transaction has the same amount yet.
duePlans.matchSingle: One transaction has the same amount but does not meet the rules for an automatic link (account, date, or another plan). Check it before linking.
duePlans.matchAmbiguous: Several transactions have the same amount. Choose the right one. None is linked automatically.

breakdown.spendingNote: Transfers between own accounts and money saved or invested are not counted as spending.
breakdown.waitingIncluded: {amount} of what is waiting for an answer is already included here. The answer only changes its pillar.
breakdown.spendingTitle: {period, select, cycle {Spending this cycle} other {Spending this month}}
breakdown.spendingRule: All spending this period by Kakeibo pillar, without what was saved, less reimbursements.
breakdown.savingsRule: Money moved into savings pockets or investments, less what was taken out of or spent from savings.
breakdown.togetherTotal: Together with spending of {spending}, the total is {total}.
breakdown.savedRule: Spending in the Savings pillar plus the net money moved into savings pockets or invested.
breakdown.incomeNote: Transfers between own accounts and reimbursements are not counted as income.
breakdown.incomeTitle: {period, select, cycle {Income this cycle} other {Income this month}}
breakdown.expectedBasis: Next salary expected on {date}, based on salaries confirmed on {receipts}. This is an estimate, not the end of the cycle.
breakdown.waitingNote: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} ({total}) still waiting for an answer. {included} of it is already included.
breakdown.reasonTooFewReceipts: the next salary date cannot be estimated yet, because fewer than three salaries are confirmed.
breakdown.reasonIrregularReceipts: the last three salary dates are irregular, so the next salary date is not guessed.
breakdown.reasonNoSalarySource: no salary source is set, so the salary used for the estimate is unknown.
breakdown.reasonNoCycle: no pay cycle is confirmed yet, so Home uses the calendar month.
breakdown.reasonSalaryOverdue: the salary was expected on {date}, but no new salary is recorded yet.
breakdown.reasonSalaryOverdueNoDate: the salary was expected earlier, but no new salary is recorded yet.
breakdown.windowExpectedSalary: Until the day before the next expected salary ({date}).
breakdown.windowNext30Days: The salary date is unknown, so the next 30 days are used (until {date}).
breakdown.scheduledRule: Unpaid bills and goal deposits not yet made, before the next salary.
breakdown.plansNote: A plan is a reminder, not a payment. Once its payment is linked, the amount moves to Spending.
breakdown.overNote: This period is {amount} over income, so nothing is safe to spend yet.
breakdown.safeRule: {period, select, cycle {Income less Spending, Saved & invested and scheduled bills until the end of the cycle.} other {Income less Spending, Saved & invested and scheduled bills until the end of the month.}}
breakdown.viewTransactions: {period, select, cycle {View transactions this cycle} other {View transactions this month}}
breakdown.includesSavingsMoves: Includes money moved to savings pockets or invested
breakdown.safetyNetRule: Reserve balance divided by monthly essential living costs.
breakdown.noDedicatedFund: No dedicated emergency fund yet — counted from all cash balances
breakdown.coverage: {monthsText}× essential costs · {days, plural, one {{daysText} day} other {{daysText} days}}
breakdown.essentialUnknown: Unknown: no complete period yet and no budget on Needs categories.

breakdown.limitedHistory: Limited history ({count, plural, one {# period} other {# periods}})
breakdown.viewPeriodsUsed: {count, plural, one {View the period used} other {View the # periods used}}
breakdown.periodsRule: Spending in the Needs pillar and with no pillar yet, less reimbursements. Transfers, investments, categories outside the budget and installment payments are not counted. Installments count through their minimum amount.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.password_too_short: Password must have at least {min} characters
errors.invalid_invite_code: This invite code is not valid.
errors.display_name_empty: The display name cannot be empty.
errors.form_invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.amount_product_required: An amount top-up needs a mutual fund product that does not track units.
errors.amount_product_trade_not_supported: This product is tracked by amount. Use Top up or Update value.
errors.amount_valuation_required: Use Update value to change this product’s invested amount or value.
errors.amount_product_must_remain_leaf: A product with top-ups cannot have pockets under it.
errors.invalid_investment_reversal: This correction would make the invested amount or value negative. Check the actual value before trying again.
errors.idempotency_mismatch: The earlier request used a different amount or data. Check the transactions before adding it again.
errors.investment_topup_lifecycle_required: Change or delete it from the investment top-up details.
errors.investment_topup_deleted: This top-up was deleted. Reload the transactions.
errors.archived_topup_account: The account or product is archived. No top-up amount can be added.
errors.funding_selection_changed: The source pocket changed. Choose the source account again.
errors.already_amount_tracked: This product is already tracked by amount.
errors.unit_mutual_fund_required: Only a mutual fund product that tracks units can switch to amount tracking.
errors.negative_investment_value: The product value is negative. Update the product value before changing how it is tracked.
errors.transaction_not_convertible: This transaction cannot become a top-up. Only a single spending without a bill, goal or schedule can be changed.
errors.liquid_funding_required: A top-up can only come from a bank account, an e-wallet or cash.
errors.device_not_found: The device was removed or not found. Reload the device list.
errors.pairing_configuration_invalid: Phone pairing is not configured on the server.
errors.session_required: Sign in again in the browser to create a pairing code.
errors.credit_parent_not_allowed: A credit account cannot have pockets or be a pocket.
errors.credit_balance_sign: The opening balance does not fit the account type. Enter credit debt as a positive number.
errors.credit_fields_not_allowed: A limit, a bill day and a payment date are only for credit accounts.
errors.credit_type_change_has_transactions: The credit account type cannot change once it has transactions or pockets.
errors.credit_account_not_allowed: A credit account cannot be used here. Choose a bank account, an e-wallet or cash.
errors.credit_fee_not_allowed: A fee can only be added when paying into a credit account, and it cannot be more than the amount.
errors.credit_movement_needs_cash: One side of a transfer must be a bank account, an e-wallet or cash.
errors.credit_terms_not_credit_purchase: Installments can only be set on a purchase made with a credit account.
errors.credit_terms_due_before_purchase: The first due date cannot be before the purchase date, {purchase_date}.
errors.credit_account_required: This is not a credit account.
errors.credit_period_invalid: The start of the period must be on or before its end.
errors.account_role_type_mismatch: The use does not fit the account type. A credit account is always Debt, an investment product is always Investments, and a bank account, e-wallet or cash uses Everyday money, Savings or Investment cash.
errors.insufficient_funds: Not enough balance. {available} available of the {required} needed.
errors.insufficient_units: Not enough investment units. {available} available of the {required} units needed.
